hooks.name: conn-session-start
hooks.description: Offer read-only Conn context at the start of a coordinated session.

action.prompt: Conn session-start reminder. If the human's current objective is coordinated through Conn, call session_status. When authentication and Project selection are unambiguous, call read_work_context before implementation. These are read-only checks. Stop on ambiguity or stale context. Do not publish, revise, release, analyze, attach evidence, propose a resolution, make a binding decision, change membership, or start polling from this hook.

hooks.name: conn-session-stop
hooks.description: Report Conn continuation state and offer the explicit finish workflow.

action.prompt: Conn stop reminder. If this turn used Conn, use only read-only Conn tools to report the active Intent revision, authoritative event cursor, unresolved collisions, evidence gaps, and known unknowns. Offer /conn-finish to the human when appropriate, but do not invoke it automatically. Do not publish, revise, release, analyze, attach evidence, propose a resolution, make a binding decision, change membership, poll, or block the user from stopping.
